summary: A cardholder makes ordinary purchases during a billing cycle, stays below the credit limit, receives a statement, and then pays the full statement balance before the due date. The scenario is designed to show an on-time full-payment path with a valid grace-period setup and no late fee or over-limit fee.
assumptions: The account has no previous balance at the start of this billing cycle, so the issuer's grace-period obligation is triggered for new purchases.
The credit limit is $1000.00 and total posted purchases in the cycle remain below that limit at all times.
The periodic statement for this cycle closes on 2025-03-31 and shows a payment due date of 2025-04-25, providing at least 25 days after statement close.
The cardholder pays the full new balance shown on the statement on 2025-04-20, which is on or before the due date.
No cash advances, international transactions, returned payments, delinquency, or other fee-triggering events occur in this scenario.
The statement reflects only purchases in this cycle and no prior unpaid interest or fees.
